## Goal
The hoid image contains the pinned `claude`, finbot has the keys it needs, and the service runs with `CLASSIFY_MODE=dry_run`.

## Scope
- Dockerfile: add `curl` (and `bash` if the slim image lacks it) for the installer. Install `claude` 2.1.312 at that exact version in the Debian runtime stage, `DISABLE_UPDATES=1`, runs as uid 10001.
- **The binary must live outside `/data`.** The installer writes under `$HOME`, finbot's home is `/data`, and the `finbot-data` volume mounts over `/data`, hiding anything installed there. Run the install with `HOME=/opt/claude` as root during the build, make it readable by uid 10001, and link `/usr/local/bin/claude` to the versioned binary. `CLAUDE_BIN` is that absolute path.
- Compose: `CLASSIFY_MODE: "dry_run"`, `CLAUDE_BIN`, `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=/data/claude` (both `.claude/` and `.claude.json` persist there, per the review finding), and an empty working directory for the CLI. Root stays `read_only`.
- `deploy.sh`: add `SLACK_APP_TOKEN`, `SLACK_USERS`, `JEV_API_KEY` and `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` to the forwarded list; add those four and `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` to the required-key loop (Socket Mode is silently off without it); refuse any `.env` that sets `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Keep the `CLASSIFY_MODE` setting in compose, never forwarded from `.env`.
- `deploy/rehearse-docker.sh`: add a `claude --version` check with a named volume mounted at `/data`, and confirm the rest still passes with the new image.

## Out of scope
- `CLASSIFY_MODE=auto` (M3-golive). Printing any env value. Other apps on hoid.

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] `docker build --build-arg GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) -t finbot .` succeeds, and with a volume over `/data`, as on hoid, `docker volume create finbot-claude-check && docker run --rm -v finbot-claude-check:/data --entrypoint claude finbot --version` prints 2.1.312 (then remove the volume).
- [ ] `./deploy/rehearse-docker.sh` passes.
- [ ] `bash -n deploy/deploy.sh`, and a test or dry check that a missing key and a present `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` both stop it.
- [ ] `grep -c 'CLASSIFY_MODE: "dry_run"' deploy/compose.yaml` → 1; `grep -c CLASSIFY_MODE deploy/deploy.sh` → 0.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green

## Deploy steps / smoke check (only if Deploy: yes)
Before deploying: confirm `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, `JEV_API_KEY`, `SLACK_APP_TOKEN` and `SLACK_USERS` are in the main `.env` without printing them.
```bash
./deploy/deploy.sh
ssh hoid 'docker inspect -f "{{.State.Health.Status}}" finbot-finbot-1'                      # healthy
ssh hoid 'docker exec finbot-finbot-1 printenv CLASSIFY_MODE'                                # dry_run
ssh hoid 'docker exec finbot-finbot-1 claude --version'                                      # 2.1.312
ssh hoid 'docker exec finbot-finbot-1 sh -c "test -z \"\$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY\" && echo absent"' # absent
ssh hoid 'docker logs finbot-finbot-1 2>&1 | grep -c "\"level\":\"ERROR\""'                  # 0, or read those lines (redacted) first
ssh hoid 'docker exec finbot-finbot-1 finbot dry-run-report | tail -1'                       # writes: 0
```
Also check the daily probe's first result, one real Slack question appears, and clicking it reports that YNAB wasn't changed.

## Result
- Status: DONE
- What changed:
  - `Dockerfile`: the runtime stage installs `claude` 2.1.312 as root with `HOME=/opt/claude`, using the reviewed `install.sh` pinned by sha256 (`3a68d340…`, the M0-4a hash; a changed installer fails the build). Only the versioned binary is kept, at `/opt/claude/versions/2.1.312` (root-owned, 0755), with a symlink at `/usr/local/bin/claude`. `curl` is purged after the install, and the build checks `claude --version` itself. `ENV DISABLE_UPDATES=1` is set after the install step.
  - `deploy/compose.yaml`: `CLASSIFY_MODE: "dry_run"`, `CLAUDE_BIN: /usr/local/bin/claude`, `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: /data/claude`. The CLI's empty cwd is `/data/claude-work`, which finbot already derives beside the DB and creates 0700 (`cmd/classify.go` `claudeConfig`), so it needs no compose key; a comment says so. Root stays `read_only`.
  - `deploy/deploy.sh`: forwards `SLACK_APP_TOKEN`, `SLACK_USERS`, `JEV_API_KEY` and `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`. Those four plus `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` join the required-key loop. It refuses a `.env` that sets `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` to a non-empty value, plain, `export`ed or quoted.
  - `deploy/test-preflight.sh` (new): runs `deploy.sh` against dummy `.env` files, with stub `git` and `ssh` so it never reaches a host. Covers each required key missing and empty, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in three forms, an empty one allowed, and an absent `.env`.
  - `deploy/rehearse-docker.sh`: the dummy env gains `JEV_API_KEY` (dry_run requires it, or finbot won't start). New checks: compose has dry_run; in the running container `CLASSIFY_MODE=dry_run`, no `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `claude --version` is 2.1.312, `CLAUDE_BIN` resolves to the pinned binary, `DISABLE_UPDATES=1`, and finbot logged `categorize enabled` with mode dry_run; also `claude --version` on a fresh named volume at `/data` with `--read-only`.
- Acceptance:
  - docker build + `claude --version` with the `finbot-claude-check` volume over `/data` → pass: `2.1.312 (Claude Code)`, run as uid 10001; volume removed.
  - `./deploy/rehearse-docker.sh` → pass, `passed=30 failed=0`.
  - `bash -n deploy/deploy.sh` → pass; `./deploy/test-preflight.sh` → pass, `passed=26 failed=0` (a missing or empty key and a set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` each stop the deploy with exit 1 before any git or ssh call).
  - `grep -c 'CLASSIFY_MODE: "dry_run"' deploy/compose.yaml` → 1; `grep -c CLASSIFY_MODE deploy/deploy.sh` → 0. Pass.
  - `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` → pass.
- Deviations from brief:
  - `curl` is installed for the installer and purged in the same layer, so it isn't in the runtime image. `bash` was already in `debian:12.15-slim`.
  - `DISABLE_UPDATES=1` can't be set while the installer runs: with it, `claude install` prints "Updates are disabled by your administrator" and installs nothing. The `ENV` comes after that step, so every runtime process has it, and the llm runner sets it per call as well.
  - The binary is moved out of the installer's `.local/share/claude/versions/` into `/opt/claude/versions/`, and the installer's state (`.claude/`, `.claude.json` with a `userID`, the launcher) is deleted from the image.
- Follow-ups for backlog: none (optional: verify `manifest.json.sig` with Anthropic's release key, per the spike's "Binary integrity" note).
- Docs follow-ups:
  - CLAUDE.md, Build & Run / Docker: mention `./deploy/test-preflight.sh`, and that the image bakes in `claude` 2.1.312 at `/usr/local/bin/claude` (bumping it means changing the `CLAUDE_VERSION` build arg, plus `CLAUDE_INSTALLER_SHA256` if the installer changed).
  - CLAUDE.md: `deploy/compose.yaml` also sets `CLASSIFY_MODE=dry_run`, `CLAUDE_BIN` and `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`. `deploy.sh` also forwards `SLACK_APP_TOKEN`, `SLACK_USERS`, `JEV_API_KEY` and `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, requires those and `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN`, and refuses `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.
  - For sup: this worktree has no `.env`, so the brief's pre-deploy check (the four keys present in the main `.env`) is still to do. Note that this shell's interactive `grep` is ugrep, which gives a wrong "present" for a missing file; use `deploy.sh`'s own loop, or `/usr/bin/grep`.
